ov: مكعب (الإنجليزية: Cube) هو فيلم رعب وخيال علمي كندي صدر في عام 1997 من إخراج فينسينزو ناتالي، وبطولة موريس دين وينت وديفيد هيوليت ونيكول دي بوير، والفيلم من إنتاج المركز الكندى للأفلام، وهو حائز على جائزة مهرجان تورونتو الدولي للأفلام.
plotEn:
A man named Alderson awakens in a cube shaped room that has hatches on each surface which all lead to a labyrinth of similar rooms. He enters another room and is killed by a hidden trelliswork-like wire trap that slices him into cubes.
Five people meet in another room: police officer Quentin, prison escape artist Rennes, designer Worth, math student Leaven and medical doctor Holloway. Quentin warns the group he has seen traps in some other rooms. Leaven notices that each hatch bears three sets of numbers. Rennes figures to make for the edge of the labyrinth by testing rooms for traps by throwing their boots in first, but is killed by an acid trap in one of the rooms; his body is dragged into the room the others were already standing in.
Leaven attempts to identify traps using the numbers, hypothesising that rooms whose plates contain prime numbers are trapped. They encounter a mentally disabled man named Kazan, whom Holloway insists be brought along. Tension rises among the group after Leaven's hypothesis is proven wrong and Quentin gets injured by razor wires in one of the rooms. Worth admits to Quentin in an ensuing argument that he was hired to design the labyrinth's outer shell. Worth believes the Cube labyrinth was created accidentally by an out-of-control bureaucratic project whose original purpose has been lost and which continues without any overseeing authority, and that the group have been placed inside only to justify its existence.
